Also compare the three datasets for spatial compatibility and recommend the choropleth zone layer.

ledger_events.query: Create the requested choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County using the available polygon/join artifacts. First inspect the artifacts to identify the polygon zone layer, zone identifier, and hospital-bed total field. If the join artifact contains only matched hospital features, aggregate bed totals by zone and join them back to the full tract polygon layer so zero-bed zones are included. Use an appropriate sequential graduated color scheme, clear legend labeled 'Total hospital beds', title 'Total Hospital Beds Across Centre County', and export a map image (PNG or PDF) plus, if possible, the final mapped polygon GeoPackage. Report only artifacts actually created and the field mappings.
